title: Focus management and restoration
description: Build a modal interaction that moves focus inside, dismisses on Escape and returns focus to its trigger without custom tab traps.
objectives: Open a named native modal dialog with predictable initial focus
Explain why focus should remain inside a modal interaction
Close on Escape and through an explicit button
Restore focus to the opener following dismissal
rubric: I opened a native dialog and found initial keyboard focus inside it.
I tested both Escape and explicit close behavior.
I confirmed focus returns to the opener and passed browser tests.
